title: Hatsune Miku — Among The Petals Dancing In The Wind〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Among The Petals Dancing In The Wind（4★）

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Those two seem awfully anxious.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Says you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Is it that obvious?
I mean, today's...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh...
Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We're here♪
And all set to have a picnic!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we're gonna need a hand laying out the tarp.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku, this is for you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A branch. Is it from a cherry blossom tree...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Mafuyu and I went to a flower shop together to buy it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
It's very cute...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I chose it myself like you said I should, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. Thank you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What did you ask for, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, nothing special.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember how we couldn't find any cherry blossom trees in SEKAI? I decided to ask Mafuyu to pick some out that she thought looked nice just for you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That way, you'd be able to see what she believes is “beautiful”, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They may not be as “beautiful” as the cherry blossoms I saw that one time, but these seemed like the best choice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mafuyu...
You too, Kanade, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know what to say...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, I'm glad we went around to so many flower shops.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heeey.
Bring that branch over here so we can gussy up our tarp!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
It's like the ground's covered in cherry blossom petals.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's nice, right?
This tarp's printed to look like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We wanted to make this picnic feel more authentic, so we decided to check out this giant decor store♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We even came across this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
A plastic umbrella printed with tons of cherry blossoms!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, it's not just the petals.
It even has branches and everything printed on it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! It's perfect for making it feel like you're sitting under a real cherry blossom tree! Try it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
It's like there's a branch over my head...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's so pretty...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, here. You should try it too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, I will...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They like it more than we expected.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Ena, Mizuki...
I'll start getting the juice and snacks out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Go for it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What would you like to drink?
We have apple juice, orange juice and some soda.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want some of that bubbly stuff.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Apple juice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay.
Kanade, can you hand me those paper cups?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sure. Oh, while we're at it, here are some chopsticks, napkins and paper plates.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, mind also handing me a paper plate?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, just a second.
The bag with the paper plates was...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll help you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
They should be around here somewhere, so can you hand some to Ena and Mafuyu when you find them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena, she'll look for the paper plates, so in the meantime, here are some paper cups, chopsticks and napkins.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's so lively today...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's sad that flowers all have to wilt at some point...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But this picnic... It's so warm...)
